authority: Player declares evacuation along with everyone from hospital wing. No further words, medical procedures, fighting or decisions by Shiki.

chronology.event: Konoha staff organize escorted evacuation through secured lower medical tunnel. Aki nonambulatory, immobilized left lower leg; Ren collects team belongings, both shoulders fully healed. Shiki joins everyone in evacuation. Initial six patients plus newly rescued hemorrhaging Konoha guard evacuate.
Evacuees navigate narrow, shaking tunnel with escort of Konoha shinobi. Pass other wounded. No attack on convoy; Shiki does not act beyond escorted evacuation.

All seven patients and team arrive, none left behind. Konoha guard with major thigh bleeding taken to surgical care alive but critical; other pelvic injury patient immobilized; Aki given cot in protected area. Aki's foot warm with circulation intact, some reduction in lateral foot sensitivity, increasing edema requires monitoring; fractures remain stable and no weight bearing allowed. Ren surveys exits on own initiative.

Konoha wounded shinobi reports western stands retaken and main stairs in Leaf control. Purple barrier around Hokage lodge remains, attackers elsewhere in village. This is report not absolute proof of whole-village state.

Team leader Asumaga Tose (established roster id kusa_leader, NOT Asuma Sarutobi) arrives with torn cloak and facial scratch, relieved all three are alive, confirms invasion appears involving Sound and perhaps Sand, says foreigners are not allowed to depart yet and will not move wounded Aki through battle. He learned Shiki surrendered semifinal and held hospital wing, asks Shiki his account of two critically injured attackers near original hospital wing for his own understanding, declines to force Ren to speak first.
Aki being watched by medics, Ren fully healthy except no new established injuries, Tose with team waits for Shiki's response; fighting elsewhere ongoing, underground med block under Leaf guard.
